verdict: partly consistent: all repeated signs keep one value; the dotted cup in the final word has no second example. The damaged line gives ليلة الـ؟ـار.
notes: The right-to-left sign counts are 16, 17, 11. The apparent letters join in the خ-sign of بخلافي. The small crossed loop after ل ق out in the left margin of l.11 supplies the ا of لقالت; the last two signs continue on l.12. The next four signs are ل ي ل ه and the last five are ا ل [dotted cup] ا ر. A medial-radical dotted form of the plain cup = ع would give الغار, but the mark occurs only once and the damage removes the letter body. The dots of the previous العذير/الغدير are ambiguous. Retain the lacuna. The letters ة/ه and ى/ي are normalized.

fit_against_record_wording.notes: بخلاي misses the caret = ف in the six-sign word. The first sign of لقالت matches ل in لو/لها, not ا. The damaged second line has two intact cipher groups of 4 and 5 signs. Its final singleton prevents confirmation of the complete word.

unresolved_positions.evidence: The singleton cup carries a clear internal dot. The undotted cup takes ع twice. The clear copy on 89r l.2 loses the corresponding letter body at the tear; a residual dot does not establish the letter.
